title: 乡人戏 Local Opera
description:
Instructions1. You can play alone at night, but it is recommended to play with roommates or friends. If it happens to be a friend's birthday, you can send him directly.

2. Tips: This game is not scary, but it can help raise blood pressure and greatly reduce the risk of blood vessel blockage. Unique groups of people can have a sleep aid.

3. You can contact us through the contact information below

Об игре

               

Background of the Story“Peach and Lee" Village is a village in the mountains, 20 minutes drive from the town, there are some planting bases in its vicinity, and some of the staff will rent a room in the village for temporary residence for the sake of convenience. The village is very harmonious, everyone knows each other. In October of that year, the protagonist of the university received a phone call from Auntie Liu, who learned that her mother was seriously ill and returned to visit her hometown, and thus the story begins.

Way of PlayingExplore this familiar and unfamiliar village from a first-person perspective.

Learn the origins and reasons behind this layout.

Game FeaturesThe story is divided into a bright line and a dark line.

The bright line is the main plot and reveals the cause of the anomaly.

The dark storyline is interspersed with the main storyline and involves exploring the village to find the original cause.

Partially open map.

PSThis game is for the joyful times when you used to play horror games with your housemates, may you cherish them.
description_short: Welcome to the mysterious village of "Folk Show"! This is a domestic plot-oriented micro-horror game that will take you into a rural story full of suspense and thriller.
